failure_patterns.explanation: The PRIME_DIRECTIVES production/demo gate rejected the runtime because a required real dependency, configuration, local-model boundary, or vendor Git checkout is missing.
next_actions: Run `make validate-prime-directives` and fix the first reported error.
Do not bypass the gate by disabling required services in production/demo mode.
Run `make vendor-repos && make vendor-status` before live validation.

patterns: cannot connect to the docker daemon
failure_patterns.explanation: Docker or Docker Compose is unavailable on the VM.
next_actions: Install Docker Engine and Docker Compose v2.
Add the user to the docker group or run with appropriate permissions.
Run `docker compose version` before rerunning validation.

failure_patterns.explanation: The GPU is not visible to Docker or the host runtime.
next_actions: Run `nvidia-smi` on the VM host.
Install or repair NVIDIA Container Toolkit.
Verify Docker Compose GPU syntax with the configured NVIDIA runtime.

failure_patterns.explanation: The local vLLM clinical model did not load or did not produce schema-valid output.
next_actions: Set VLLM_MODEL to a real model that fits the GPU memory.
Inspect `docker compose logs vllm-clinical`.
Use a smaller model or lower GPU memory utilization if the model is too large.

failure_patterns.explanation: One or more Harvard MIMS vendored repositories or services are unavailable.
next_actions: Run `make vendor-repos` on a networked VM to clone or fast-forward pull real Git repositories.
Run `make vendor-status` and confirm every MIMS repo reports OK.
Do not use zip-extracted vendor folders for production/demo validation.
Inspect service logs for optimuskg-service, tooluniverse-service, and medea-service.

failure_patterns.explanation: OpenSearch is unhealthy, unavailable, or missing required indexes.
next_actions: Run `make init-opensearch` after OpenSearch is healthy.
Inspect `docker compose logs opensearch`.
Confirm OPENSEARCH_PUBLIC_URL points to the VM service port.

failure_patterns.explanation: Postgres is unavailable or the required metadata schema is missing.
next_actions: Run `make init-postgres` after Postgres is healthy.
Inspect `docker compose logs postgres`.
Confirm POSTGRES_PUBLIC_DSN points to the VM database port.

failure_patterns.explanation: Docling document extraction is unavailable or failed on the integration report.
next_actions: Inspect `docker compose logs docling-service`.
Confirm docling dependencies installed successfully in the service image.
Run the integration against a valid, readable oncology PDF.

failure_patterns.explanation: The review packet did not meet the Translume MVP completeness or safety contract.
next_actions: Inspect the generated review packet export.
Fix the first missing artifact or unsafe phrase upstream.
Rerun `make live-vm-validate` after the artifact path is corrected.

failure_patterns.explanation: The Gradio Oncologist Cockpit did not start or did not return a real HTTP response.
next_actions: Inspect `docker compose logs translume-ui`.
Confirm docker/ui.Dockerfile runs `python -m translume_ui.app` rather than Uvicorn.
Confirm TRANSLUME_API_BASE_URL points to http://translume-api:8080 inside Docker.
